events.title: Plink Lab Coming to Next Fest!
events.summary: The Plink Lab Demo has had a lot of changes since the first playtest and demo was released. The game has undergone a complete art update and we've updated the capsule art to match the game's new art better. I'm excited that Plink Lab will be participating in the October Next Fest! The full game will follow soon after and will include 20 levels, 14 different ball types, achievements, additional character work, and more!
